services.name: 15% Off Laser Hair Removal
services.description: Start your laser package at 15% off through August 31 — the ideal time to begin before next summer.
services.fullDescription:
Laser hair removal works on a schedule, and August is the smart month to start. Sessions run 4–6 weeks apart, so beginning now means you're well ahead by the time next summer arrives.

All laser services are 15% off from August 1–31 for National Wellness Month — single sessions and areas alike, small or large.

Book a consultation first if you've never had laser with us. Laura will check your skin and hair type and map out how many sessions your area needs before you commit to anything.

Discount is applied at checkout. Offer ends August 31.
benefits: All laser areas included, small and large
